name: Zuzana Holubová
bio:
Zuzana's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for disassembling and rebuilding her father's old Škoda. This mechanical curiosity led her to pursue engineering, graduating top of her class at the Czech Technical University in Prague. She started her career in a small rally team, learning the ropes of vehicle dynamics and data analysis under immense pressure. Her ability to diagnose complex problems quickly and efficiently earned her a reputation as a rising star.

Zuzana joined ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport five years ago, bringing a calm and methodical approach to the high-stakes environment of touring car racing. She's known for her meticulous preparation, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to extract maximum performance from her drivers and their cars. Zuzana is a strong believer in fostering a collaborative environment within the team, prioritizing open communication and shared goals. Her unique skill lies in predicting potential issues before they arise, allowing for proactive solutions and minimizing downtime.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, layered, often pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: A slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of herbal tea before every race.
